summary: Adventure game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Stray

primary.why: Stray's PC release is the strongest capture/settings route for the single-player adventure, while PlayStation, Xbox, Switch, and Mac ports are valid access paths with platform-specific performance constraints.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC version. Record storefront/build, graphics settings, controller/keyboard, resolution, accessibility settings, completion route, collectible state, and whether console/Switch ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting a specific platform.
secondary.why: PC has the best capture/settings control.

all_releases.fidelity: Original release family, with PC preferred for capture/settings.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: PC is the practical fidelity and capture route for the same core game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record build, graphics settings, input method, and collectible/completion state.
